name: report.append_finding
description: Record an investigation finding on the case, citing the specific evidence it's based on. This is the only tool that mutates case state and always requires analyst confirmation before executing.

finding_text.description: The finding, in plain language, suitable for inclusion in the investigation report.

severity.description: Severity level (e.g. Low, Medium, High, Critical).

evidence_refs.description: Event UIDs or memory-plugin-result IDs that support this finding.
